verdict.rationale: YYLO Skills is a set of agent skills for Claude Code, Codex, Pi and Cursor that teach agents to drive the YYLO CLI and Ledger, so users steer the product by asking the agent. The evidence shows skills for ledger task management, project understanding, planning and the Ralph loop, which act on user requests and translate them into `yy` commands. missing for 10: an explicit documented example of natural-language prompts triggering the skills, a description of how skill invocation or intent matching works, and independent or hands-on corroboration that natural-language operation works in practice.
